Description
Sawah Sari Villa is a beautiful family home that truly ticks all the boxes. Located at the end of a quiet gang, the property offers ample parking for both a car and motorbike. You enter into a light-filled open-plan kitchen, dining, and living area that looks out over the garden and swimming pool, with lush green views beyond.

The layout is ideal for families, with a guest toilet and two interconnecting bedrooms on the left-hand side, one of which features charming built-in bunk beds. On the opposite side of the villa, still fully undercover, is the spacious master bedroom. The garden includes a lovely cabana, perfect for entertaining or relaxing while keeping an eye on the children in the pool.

At the edge of the property is a small river, set well below the level of the land, bordered by mature trees and open rice paddy views, creating a peaceful and private outlook. The villa is fully equipped with all conveniences, including a laundry and pantry, ample storage, and is presented in excellent condition with nothing further to do.

With a long lease running until the end of March 2054 and a fantastic location on the edge of trendy Pererenan, this property represents a great entry into the Bali property market, whether as a family home or a solid investment.
